{{Quote|You know me traitor. And it's time for your companions to die, and for you to be taken back to your father for questioning.|Tola Annax to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
'''Tola Annax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She served under [[Gavar Khai]] and led the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces on the [[Nam Chorios/Legends|ground]] during the [[Operation Shieldfall|Battle on Nam Chorios]]. When she initially confronted their targets [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Vestara Khai]], she had three Sith attack them, however all were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and she escaped. Later, when Khai switched his allegiances from the Tribe to [[Abeloth]], Annax went along. After Khai was [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|slain]] by his daughter Vestara, Annax took his place as head of [[Abeloth's fleet]]. However, not long afterwards, Abeloth stripped Annax of her powers, and filled her with dark energy, leaving her on [[Upekzar]] as bait for a trap for the Jedi, where she died from the massive amount of energy.
